The Last Supper at Ravenwood Inn

Investigator's Notebook

Maren (Innkeeper)

Personality: Honesty 0.9, Suspicion 0.2, Greed 0.1. Protective, observant, and hates dishonest trade deals.

Dorian (Merchant)

Personality: Honesty 0.3, Greed 0.8, Suspicion 0.4. Shifty merchant who loves shiny items and hoards invoices.

Sable (Scholar)

Personality: Honesty 0.8, Curiosity 0.9, Suspicion 0.7. Extremely analytical, keeps notes on maps and rooms.

Fen (Retired Soldier)

Personality: Honesty 0.7, Loyalty 0.8, Openness 0.2. Loyal soldier, highly protective, guards entry points.

Vex (Performer)

Personality: Honesty 0.5, Charm 0.85, Suspicion 0.3. Fast speaker, charismatic, keeps watch on stable movements.

No clues collected yet. Ask questions or search rooms to find evidence.
